    listPatterns(options = {}) {
        const { limit, offset } = toPage(options.limit, options.offset);
        const where = options.taskType !== undefined ? 'WHERE task_type = ?' : '';
        const params = options.taskType !== undefined ? [String(options.taskType)] : [];
        const total = this.db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM reasoning_patterns ${where}`).get(...params)?.c ?? 0;
        const rows = this.db
            .prepare(`SELECT id, ts, task_type, approach, success_rate, uses, avg_reward, tags, metadata
         FROM reasoning_patterns ${where} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`)
            .all(...params, limit, offset);
        const items = rows.map((row) => ({
            id: row.id,
            taskType: row.task_type,
            approach: row.approach,
            successRate: row.success_rate,
            uses: row.uses,
            avgReward: row.avg_reward,
            tags: safeJsonParse(row.tags, []),
            metadata: safeJsonParse(row.metadata, {}),
            createdAt: row.ts,
        }));
        return { items, total, limit, offset };
    }
